title: 'press the king's grievance (will)' at the Elder's House failed its shown die roll three times in a row (2, 7, 7 vs DC 11) yet succeeded anyway on the third try ('Patience does what a quick word could not'), meaning the displayed dice mechanic did not actually determine the outcome. The roll/DC framing misleads the player about how the check resolves.
